'''Jonna''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual that lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He worked in [[Nagem Dr'Lar]]'s salvage team, searching for debris of the destroyed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] in the jungles of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].

One day in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] he discovered that he had lost a family heirloom and went back to an old work site of the salvage team to search for it. When he didn't return, Dr'Lar asked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to search for him. The spacer found the work site devastated by a scavenger attack and a bloody trail leading off to the brush. Not far from the work site he found all that remained of Jonna's body and brought back the sad news to Dr'Lar.
